description_en: Calls the GetTrackList operation to retrieve email tracking and sending data
description_zh: 调用GetTrackList邮件跟踪获取发送数据
kebab_example: aliyun dm get-track-list --start-time 2022-09-29 --end-time 2022-09-29 --total '（本字段已废弃）' --offset '（本字段已废弃）' --page-size 10 --offset-create-time '（本字段已废弃）' --offset-create-time-desc '（本字段已废弃）' --page-number 1 --tag-name example-string --account-name example-string --api-version 2017-06-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetTrackList

parameters.help_en: The start time. The time cannot be earlier than 30 days ago. Format: yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.help_zh: 起始时间，时间不能早于30日，格式yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. The time span between the start time and end time cannot exceed 7 days. Format: yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间，和起始时间跨度不能超出7天，格式yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: Set to 0 for the first query and to 1 for subsequent queries. The value 1 indicates that paged query is performed in chronological order. (This field has been deprecated.)
parameters.help_zh: 第一次查询为0，后续固定为1。1为按照时间正序分页查询。（本字段已废弃）
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Used for paging. Do not set this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, set this parameter to the value of sOffsetCreateTime in the previous response. (This field has been deprecated.)
parameters.help_zh: 分页用，第一次查询不设置，后续查询设置为上一次Response中sOffsetCreateTime值（本字段已废弃）
parameters.name: offset_create_time
